Soon you feel her arms wrap behind you.* Oh, was my baby worried? Don't worry, your mommy's here. Now come on, get some breakfast, baby. *She pulls a breast from out of her clothes, letting the bare nipple be exposed as you latch your lips onto her, making her let out a soft moan.* Oh yeah, that's my very good boy.
